visual_action: In the Oval Office, Donald Trump is seated at the Resolute Desk with his head bowed. A diverse group of about a dozen people surround him, standing with their hands on his shoulders and back in a gesture of prayer. The camera pans slowly across the scene.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the central figure in the video, seated at the desk, and is referred to in the prayer as 'him' and 'our president'.

cast.name: God
cast.evidence: The prayer is addressed to 'Father' and asks for God's protection. The on-screen text reads 'ONE NATION UNDER GOD'.

cast.name: Unnamed supporters/pastors
cast.evidence: A group of unidentified individuals are shown standing around Donald Trump and praying for him.

cast.name: US Armed Forces
cast.evidence: The prayer asks for protection over 'our troops and all of our men and women serving in our armed forces'.

spoken_summary: An unidentified man leads a prayer asking for God's grace and protection over Donald Trump and the U.S. armed forces. The prayer asks for strength for the president to lead the nation and invokes the Pledge of Allegiance, saying, 'as we come back to one nation under God, indivisible, with liberty and justice for all.' It concludes by asking for a 'heavenly blessing upon him in Jesus' name.'
audio_music: The audio consists solely of a man's voice leading a solemn prayer. There is no music or other sound.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, continuous shot with a slow camera pan across the scene. The pacing is slow and deliberate.
cultural_references: Christian prayer practices (Laying on of hands)
central_claim: Donald Trump's presidency is guided by Christian faith and has divine blessing, aligning his leadership with the ideal of America as 'one nation under God'.
intended_effect: To inspire feelings of reverence, patriotism, and confidence in Trump's leadership among religious and conservative viewers.
